posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Hello everyone.
I'll be releasing my game very soon on Steam and it will include a free demo.
I would very much like the data from the demo to be carried over into the main game.
I plan on copying/pasting the game and editing it out to have 2 version. 1 Main and 1 demo.
What would be the best way to go about this?

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: Demo should be made from the full game version I think, I mean, after cutting the full game to a demo, the saves should work after transferring. But if the demo is separate, and then you make another game on that demo that isn't there now, I'm not sure if it will work.

posts.author: ARIOSODEV
posts.body:
Please take my words with a grain of salt, I've never touched MZ in my life nor do I own it, but I think the person above me is correct. If the later versions of RPG Maker work anything like I think they do, then it can go two ways, and if you want the demo save files to still work with the main game, you have to
first
finish the main game and then create a seperate demo project out of that.
If you create the demo, and then finish the main game, then you run the risk of too many things in the Database, Maps, Variables, etc... changing so much that the demo save file wouldn't work properly.
